faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about BONDKOIN Node Mining, Token Conversion, and On-Chain Payouts.
faq.q1: What is BONDKOIN Node Mining and how does it work?
faq.a1: BONDKOIN is a high-yield node mining reward platform on BNB Smart Chain. You register for free, tap 'Mine' once every 24 hours, and your device node terminal accrues BONDKOIN Points. There is zero battery drain and zero electricity cost.
faq.q2: How does the token conversion to $BONDKOIN work?
faq.a2: All accrued internal points convert at a fixed 3:1 ratio (3 Points = 1 $BONDKOIN BEP-20 token). When you withdraw, $BONDKOIN tokens are transferred directly to your connected BNB Chain address.
faq.q3: Can I stack multiple booster packages?
faq.a3: Yes! Node booster packages are fully stackable. You can activate multiple $1, $5, $10, or $50 booster node rigs simultaneously to achieve massive hourly hashrates.
faq.q4: How does the referral multiplier work?
faq.a4: As you invite new miners with your personal referral link, your tier increases from Level 1 (×1) up to Level 6 (×8). This multiplier scales your effective mining accrual dramatically.
faq.q5: What are the requirements for withdrawing?
faq.a5: To withdraw: 1) You need at least 100 points, 2) Complete basic KYC verification to prove unique identity, and 3) Maintain a 7-day cadence between withdrawal requests.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.intro: How node mining, boosters, verification and payouts actually work here.

mining.q: What does “node mining” mean on BONDKOIN?
mining.a:
It is an eco-friendly scheduled reward accrual model where your connected device operates as a mining node. Your account earns BONDKOIN Points at an hourly rate without heavy battery drain.

Points are internal units. Only a withdrawal converts them to on-chain $BONDKOIN.

cooldown.q: Why can I only tap Mine once a day?
cooldown.a: Tapping Mine banks whatever has accrued and starts a 24-hour cooldown. Points keep accruing between taps, up to a ceiling of 24 hours' worth, so nothing is lost if you come back a little late — but accrual stops once you hit that ceiling.

conversion.a: Three points convert to one $BONDKOIN. The rate is fixed in the platform and applied when you withdraw.

minWithdrawal.a: 100 points, and one withdrawal request per week. Your identity must be verified first.

withdrawTime.q: How long does a withdrawal take?
withdrawTime.a:
Points leave your balance the moment you request, so a pending request cannot be spent twice. An operator then reviews it before the on-chain transfer is sent.

If a request is rejected, the points are returned to your balance and the reason is shown on the withdrawal page.

kyc.q: Why do you need my ID?
kyc.a:
Verification is required before your first withdrawal, so payouts go to real, distinct people rather than to hundreds of accounts run by one person.

You can mine, complete tasks and buy boosters without verifying. Only withdrawal is gated.

boosters.a: A booster adds to your hourly rate for 30 days, and they stack — buying two adds both bonuses. They are paid in USDT on BNB Chain, directly from your own wallet.

boosterFailed.q: I paid for a booster but it didn't activate.
boosterFailed.a:
Payments are verified automatically against the chain. A payment is rejected if it used the wrong token, went to the wrong address, came from an address other than the one you entered, was for less than the price, or has not yet reached the required number of confirmations.

“Waiting for confirmations” resolves on its own — submit the same transaction hash again in a minute. For anything else, open a ticket with the hash.

referrals.a: Inviting people raises a multiplier on your mining rate. The tier and multiplier currently applied are shown on your dashboard and profile.

tasks.a: Small repeatable actions that credit points directly. Each has its own reward and cooldown, both shown on the card.

terms.title: Terms of service
terms.intro: The rules for using BONDKOIN. Plain language, no surprises.
terms.updated: These terms are a working draft and have not been reviewed by a lawyer.

service.a: BONDKOIN is a node rewards platform. “Mining” here means scheduled node reward accrual on your account. There is no proof-of-work hardware wear, and no guarantee of profit.

eligibility.a: You must be old enough to enter a contract where you live, and using the service must be legal there. One account per person. Accounts created to farm rewards may be limited or closed.

points.a: Points are internal units with no value outside this platform until withdrawn. Rates, bonuses and conversion may be adjusted, and adjustments apply going forward, not retroactively.

payouts.a:
Withdrawals require verified identity, a minimum balance, and are limited to one request per week. Requests are reviewed before payment.

On-chain transfers are irreversible. You are responsible for the destination address you provide; funds sent to an address you mistyped cannot be recovered.

conduct.a: Multiple or automated accounts, forged verification documents, and any attempt to manipulate accrual, referrals or payment verification. We may suspend an account and withhold a payout while investigating.

liability.a: The service is provided as-is. We are not liable for losses from network outages, chain congestion, third-party wallets, or your own loss of account or wallet access.

changes.a: These terms may change. Continued use after a change means you accept the updated version.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: What we collect, why, and how long we keep it.
privacy.updated: This policy is a working draft and have not been reviewed by a lawyer.

collect.a: Your email address, the country you select, and a device fingerprint used to detect duplicate accounts. We also record your activity on the platform: accrual, taps, tasks, referrals, booster purchases and withdrawal requests.

kycData.a:
If you verify your identity we collect your name, document type and number, country, photographs of that document, and a selfie.

This is the most sensitive data we hold. It is used only to decide whether to approve your verification and to satisfy the obligations that come with paying people out.

use.a: To run your account, calculate rewards, detect abuse and duplicate accounts, review verification, and process withdrawals. We do not sell your data.

share.a:
The wallet address and amount of a withdrawal are written to a public blockchain and are permanently visible to anyone. Nothing else about you is published.

We use infrastructure providers to host the service, who process data on our behalf.

retain.a: Account and transaction records are kept while your account exists and afterwards where records of payouts must be retained. Verification documents are kept for as long as required for that purpose and no longer.

rights.a: You can ask what we hold about you, ask for corrections, or ask for deletion. Deletion requests are limited by records we are required to keep, and cannot remove anything already written to the blockchain.

contact.a: Open a support ticket from your profile and mark it as a privacy request.
